--- READING ---------------------------------------------------------------
  The payload process (the one that actually performed the base64 reconstruction) is
  the last powershell.exe, whose parent is the other powershell.exe. Its command line
  carries -Command and [Convert]::FromBase64String(...) and NO encoded-command switch,
  so the DET-001 v2 trigger returns no match for it. The process that DOES match the
  trigger is the WinRS transport powershell above it, which is the transport artefact
  present for every WinRM call in this lab and is baselined by BASE-01.
